app.name: Newses
app.waking: Waking up the server. This can take up to 30 seconds after a period of inactivity.

offline.title: Offline reading
offline.enable: Keep articles on this device to read without a connection
offline.stored: {entries} articles kept, {contents} with their text, {images} images ({size})
offline.unsupported: This server needs an update before articles can be kept offline.
offline.notPersisted: The browser may clear these articles when it runs low on space.
offline.evicted: The browser cleared the articles kept on this device. They are being downloaded again.
offline.notStored: This article's text isn't on this device yet. It will download the next time you're online.
offline.notSaved: You're offline, so this change wasn't saved.
offline.pending: {n} change waiting to be sent | {n} changes waiting to be sent
offline.refused: A change made offline couldn't be saved: {error}
offline.signOutPending: {n} change made offline hasn't reached the server yet. Signing out deletes it. | {n} changes made offline haven't reached the server yet. Signing out deletes them.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

connect.title: Connect to a server
connect.prompt: Enter the address of your Newses server.
connect.unreachable: Couldn't reach a Newses server at {host}.
connect.incompatible: The server at {host} runs a version of Newses this app doesn't support. Update the app or the server.
connect.older: This server runs an older version of Newses ({version}). Some features may not work until it is updated.

desktop.notifications: Notify me about new entries while the app is in the background
desktop.closeToTray: Keep running in the tray when the window is closed
desktop.launchAtLogin: Start when I sign in to my computer

updates.title: Update available
updates.readyPrompt: Newses {version} is ready. Restart the app to update.
updates.availablePrompt: Newses {version} is available. Download and install it to update.

login.name: User name
login.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
login.codePrompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
login.expired: Sign-in took too long. Please start again.

tree.label: Feeds
tree.dropTopLevel: Drop here to move to the top level

entries.fullTextShown: Showing the article from its web page; press Full text again for the feed's version.
entries.selectPrompt: Select an article to read it.
entries.notFound: This article is no longer available.
entries.noContent: This article has no content; open the original to read it.
entries.scoreHint: Lists highlight or hide articles by score; see Settings.
entries.scoreInvalid: Enter a whole number from −{max} to {max}

labels.title: Labels
labels.hint: Each label is listed in the sidebar with its unread articles.
labels.deleteConfirm: Delete “{label}”? It is removed from all its articles.
labels.caption: Name
labels.lowContrast: Contrast is {ratio}:1; at least 4.5:1 keeps the label readable.

filters.title: Filters
filters.hint: Filters run in order on each new article. Enabled filters apply to new articles; Apply runs one on the articles you already have.
filters.deleteConfirm: Delete the filter “{title}”? Articles it already changed stay as they are.
filters.applyConfirm: Run “{title}” on all your articles now? Starred, published, noted, labelled, and shared articles are never deleted.
filters.name: Name
filters.inverse: Act on articles that do not match
filters.patternHint: Patterns are regular expressions (RE2 syntax), matched ignoring case; start with (?-i) to match case.
filters.label: Label
filters.testSummary: {matched} of your {checked} most recent articles match.

tags.title: Tags
tags.hint: Separate tags with commas; up to {n}.
tags.none: No tags yet. Feeds' categories become tags, and you can add your own to any article.

sharing.notShared: Create a public link anyone can open, without signing in. You can revoke it at any time.
sharing.linkHint: Anyone with this link can read the article. It stays available while shared, even after the feed drops it.
sharing.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the text and copy it instead.
sharing.publishedFeedHint: Articles you publish appear in this RSS feed. Anyone with the address can subscribe to it.
sharing.regenerateConfirm: The current address stops working, so anyone subscribed to it will need the new one.

reading.title: Article text
reading.sample: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Feeds you follow are shown in this font, at this size, up to this width.

archive.title: Archive: {feed}
archive.selectPrompt: Select a past article to read it.
archive.hint: A past article. Star, publish, label, or note it to bring it back to its feed.

catchUp.title: Mark as read
catchUp.olderThan: Older than one day | Older than {n} days
catchUp.done: No articles marked read. | One article marked read. | {n} articles marked read.

feeds.fullTextHint: Fetch each new article's web page and show its text first.
feeds.title: Title
feeds.unsubscribeConfirm: Unsubscribe from “{feed}”? Starred and published articles are kept.

subscribe.title: Subscribe to a feed
subscribe.urlHint: A feed URL, or a web page that links to its feed.
subscribe.choose: This page offers several feeds. Choose one:

appearance.adjustHint: Changes apply to the theme you use and are saved as you make them.
appearance.colorsHint: Switch the mode to edit the other mode's colours.
appearance.lowContrast: Contrast {ratio}:1 is below the {min}:1 that WCAG AA needs.
appearance.articleFontHint: Used unless Preferences sets an article font.
appearance.importInvalid: That file is not a theme this server accepts.
appearance.name: Name
appearance.publishLowContrast: Some of “{name}”'s colours are below WCAG AA contrast, so others may find it hard to read. Publish it anyway?
appearance.published: Published {name}: everyone on this server can use it.
appearance.unpublishText: Withdraw “{name}” by {author} from everyone else? Anyone using it goes back to Original.
appearance.deleteText: Delete “{name}”? Anyone using it goes back to Original.
appearance.discardText: Your adjustments to this theme will be lost.

settings.updatesHint: Defaults for your feeds; each feed can override them.
settings.showContentPreview: Show a preview of each article in the list
settings.markReadOnScroll: In the combined layout, mark articles read as they scroll past
settings.confirmCatchUp: Ask before marking many articles read
settings.proxyImages: Load article images through this server, so image hosts cannot see your address
settings.deleteCategoryConfirm: Delete “{category}”? Its feeds and subcategories move to its parent.
settings.dragHint: Drag feeds and categories in the sidebar, or set their category and position when editing them.
settings.failing: Failed once | Failed {n} times in a row
settings.scoreHideHint: Hidden articles stay in Starred, Published, labels, and tags.

account.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, not a common password.
account.tooShort: The new password needs at least 8 characters.
account.tooCommon: That password is too common. Choose another.
account.throttled: Too many wrong attempts. Try again later.
account.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
account.changeRequired: This account was set up with a generated password. Choose your own to continue.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.offSummary: Sign-in asks for a code from an authenticator app as well as your password.
twoFactor.scanPrompt: Scan this code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.manualEntry: Or enter this key by hand:
twoFactor.codesPrompt: Store these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your authenticator. They will not be shown again.
twoFactor.enabled: Two-factor authentication is on. Other devices were signed out.
twoFactor.codeHint: A code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
twoFactor.wrongPasswordOrCode: The password or code is wrong.
twoFactor.regeneratePrompt: Enter a code from your authenticator app. Your old recovery codes will stop working.

appPasswords.title: App passwords
appPasswords.summary: Apps that use the TTRSS or Google Reader API sign in with an app password instead of your password. They skip two-factor authentication, so give each app its own and revoke any you no longer use.
appPasswords.name: Name
appPasswords.nameHint: The app or device it is for, e.g. "Reeder on iPhone".
appPasswords.createdPrompt: Enter this password in {name} together with your user name. It will not be shown again.
appPasswords.revokeConfirm: Revoke {name}? Apps using it will be signed out.
appPasswords.ttrssUrl: Server URL for TTRSS apps (TTRSS for Android, Newsboat)
appPasswords.greaderUrl: Server URL for Google Reader apps (ReadYou)
appPasswords.freshrssUrl: Server URL for apps that offer only FreshRSS
appPasswords.syncInterval: Sign in with your user name and an app password. Set apps to sync no more often than every {minutes} minutes.

users.resetHint: The user is signed out everywhere and their app passwords stop working.
users.resetTwoFactorConfirm: Turn off two-factor authentication for {login} and sign them out everywhere? They can set it up again after signing in.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.settingsHint: Each action can have up to four keys or two-key sequences. Your changes replace that action's defaults.
shortcuts.disabledHint: Single-key shortcuts are turned off in Preferences, so these bindings do nothing until you turn them on.
shortcuts.conflicts: Some keys are bound more than once, so only one of their actions runs: {list}
shortcuts.resetAllConfirm: Every action goes back to its default keys.
shortcuts.recordHint: With the Keys field focused, press a key, or two keys in turn for a sequence. Pressing a third key starts over. Tab moves on; Esc cancels.
shortcuts.blocked: These keys clash with {actions}: one is the start of the other. Choose different keys.
shortcuts.duplicate: This action already has these keys.
shortcuts.moved: These keys are bound to {actions}; saving moves them to this action.

ops.stale: Monitoring last ran {when}. Check that the worker (Docker) or the dispatch schedule (AWS) is running.
ops.neverChecked: Monitoring has not run yet. Check that the worker (Docker) or the dispatch schedule (AWS) is running.
ops.hostsHint: Requests to each site, busiest first. More than {budget} requests to one site in an hour raises an alert.
ops.hostTrend: Requests per hour (top) and failed or rate-limited requests (bottom).
